items: Common Trap: Questions often incorrectly state that the Wildlife Protection Act comes under NGT.
Procedure Trap: NGT is NOT bound by the Civil Procedure Code (CPC); it follows the principles of natural justice.
Appeals Jurisdiction: Appeals against NGT orders lie directly before the Supreme Court, not High Courts.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The tribunal was established in 2010, making India the third country globally to set up such a specialized body.
The Wildlife Protection Act is explicitly NOT covered under NGT jurisdiction.
Appeals against tribunal decisions go directly to the Supreme Court.
It operates on the 'Polluter Pays' principle and is not bound by the Civil Procedure Code.
